theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_cr_density_rescale
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P) (t : ℝ), 0 < t → (∀ w : Euclid P, limsup (fun ρ : ℝ => (ENNReal.ofReal (t⁻¹ ^ n) • μ.map (dilation y t)) (ball w ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) = limsup (fun ρ : ℝ => μ (ball (y + t • w) ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)) ∧ ∀ w : Euclid P, (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → (ENNReal.ofReal (t⁻¹ ^ n) • μ.map (dilation y t)) (ball w ε) ≠ 0) ↔ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → μ (ball (y + t • w) ε) ≠ 0
